membership.title: Membership
membership.stripeWarning: Stripe is not configured for this academy — you can prepare plans and the page, but real checkout will fail until you <link>configure Stripe in Administration → Payments</link>.
membership.plansDescription: Price, billing interval, strikethrough price and trial days. The Stripe price is created only on the first payment (and rotated when the price changes).
membership.plansEmpty: There are no plans yet. Create the first one below.
membership.planNeedsNamePrice: The plan needs a name and a valid price.
membership.planDeleted: Plan deleted (or deactivated if it already had sales).
membership.configDescription: Content of /unete and what the purchase grants. The testimonial is only shown if you fill it in (quote + author).
membership.subheadlinePlaceholder: Unlock every course, updates and the community.
membership.showCoursesLabel: Show the course catalog on the page
membership.trialLimitLabel: Lessons visible per course during the trial period
membership.trialLimitHelp: While the subscription is in trial, each course shows only its first N lessons; the rest appear locked with the option to pay now. 0 = no limit (full access during the trial too).
membership.trialLimitInvalid: Indicate how many lessons are visible during the trial (0 to 1000; 0 = no limit).
membership.coursePricesTitle: Individual reference price per course (what they cost separately, e.g. on your sales site)

referrals.title: Referral program
referrals.intro: Members share their /unete link and earn a % of the real payments of whoever joins. Payouts are manual with an external reference (v1 without automatic payments).
referrals.configDescription: Changes do not recalculate commissions already accrued: each commission seals the % in force at the time of payment.
referrals.requireMembershipLabel: Require an active membership from the referrer
referrals.memberCopyPlaceholder: E.g.: Share your link and earn 30% of every payment.
referrals.configSaved: Configuration saved. It only affects future accruals.
referrals.referrersDescription: Approved balance = pending payout. Settling marks the commissions as paid with the reference of the real payment.
referrals.referrersEmpty: There are no referrers yet: they will appear when members generate their link.
referrals.liquidatePrompt:
Settle {amount} to {code}.

External payment reference (bank transfer, PayPal…):
referrals.commissionsEmpty: Nothing to show with this filter.
referrals.revokePrompt:
Revoke the {amount} commission.

Reason (required, the member will see it):

marketplace.title: Module marketplace
marketplace.intro: Upload a .zip package signed by Didacta to add a module to this instance without restarting the API. Modules become available for per-tenant activation in Settings.
marketplace.uploadDescription: Drag the .zip here or pick it from disk. The instance validates the signature + bundle lint + SQL migrations before accepting.
marketplace.maxNote: Maximum 50 MiB · only packages signed by Didacta
marketplace.unverifiedBody: The module {module} was installed successfully but does not have a verified signature from Didacta.
marketplace.unverifiedExplain: This means the package was uploaded directly and did not go through the official marketplace review and signing process.
marketplace.unverifiedAdvice: Only trust modules from sources you know. If you do not recognize this package, consider uninstalling it from the module list.
marketplace.installedDescription: Instance-level list. Per-tenant activation still lives in <link>Settings</link>.
marketplace.installedEmpty: There are no modules installed via marketplace yet. The modules compiled into the Docker image (mod.courses, mod.community, etc.) are managed from Settings.
marketplace.confirmUninstall: Uninstall "{module}"? This action cannot be undone.
marketplace.teaserDescription: Soon you will be able to browse the public module catalog on didacta.io and push modules to this instance with one click. The flow is described in docs/MARKETPLACE-WEB-SPEC.md. Meanwhile, the offline upload above is the supported way.

license.title: License
license.intro: Activate an Enterprise license by pasting the key you received when you bought it. Verification is local — the instance does not call any external server to check it.
license.managedByEnvDescription: The key is set by the deployment operator via the DIDACTA_LICENSE_KEY environment variable — it cannot be changed from here.
license.pasteJwtDescription: Paste the JWT (it starts with "eyJ") you received when buying your Enterprise license.
license.capabilitiesDescription: Enterprise features enabled by this license.
license.removeDialogDescription: The installation will go back to Community mode (or to the DIDACTA_LICENSE_KEY value if the operator set one via env). Enterprise capabilities are deactivated immediately.

moduleDetail.tenantActivationDescription: Controls whether this module is active for the current tenant. Activation/deactivation is managed from <link>Settings → Modules</link>.
moduleDetail.configDescription: Configurable values defined by the module. The form is generated automatically from the schema declared in module.json.
moduleDetail.configWip: The configuration renderer is under development.
moduleDetail.configWipRef: See DISC-001.4 — Config Schema Form Renderer
moduleDetail.uiNoSurface: This module has no graphical interface for the admin surface.
moduleDetail.uiBackendOnly: The module only has a backend or its UI lives in another surface (student, instructor, etc.)
moduleDetail.uiDescription: UI loaded dynamically from the module bundle.
moduleDetail.routesDescription: HTTP routes registered by the module under {ns}.
moduleDetail.routesWip: The route list will be extracted from the module manifest.

categories.onlyAdmins: Only tenant administrators can manage course categories.
categories.title: Course categories
categories.intro: Curate the official catalog categories with color and icon. The builder offers this list to the instructor as a select; the catalog and the course card paint the chip with the configured style.
categories.listEmpty: There are no categories yet. Create the first one in the form on the right.
categories.count: {count, plural, one {# curated category} other {# curated categories}}.
categories.confirmDelete: Delete the category "{name}"? Courses that have it will keep showing the name as plain text.
categories.editDescription: Change the name, color or icon. Courses already using this category update instantly.
categories.newDescription: Create an official category. The name is an exact match with the course category, so keep it consistent.

broadcasts.title: Community announcements
broadcasts.intro: Send an email + notification to every member. It goes out in batches to avoid flooding email; each email carries an unsubscribe link.
broadcasts.importantHelp: Important announcements are sent even to those who unsubscribed from community emails.
broadcasts.queued: Announcement queued: it will be sent in batches.
broadcasts.historyEmpty: You have not sent any announcements yet.

metrics.intro: The Monday KPIs: community, sales and membership health. 30-day window unless stated otherwise.
metrics.npsEmpty: no responses yet — filled by the post-class surveys
metrics.weeklyRevenueDescription: Course and membership payments, last 12 weeks.
metrics.emptyWindow: No data yet in this window.
